scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @orbiguild/contracts && npm run build -w @orbiguild/core
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names web,runner "npm run dev -w @orbiguild/web" "npm run dev -w @orbiguild/runner"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @orbiguild/runner && npm run build -w @orbiguild/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run docs:check
